intended_object: The canonical immersion into S of the subscheme of S over which a given S-point P of the elliptic curve E has (naive) exact order N, for N invertible on S. This is inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: `naiveExactOrderPreimage hN P` is defined as the fibre product of `P.left : S → E` with the composite `naiveExactOrderOpens E hN → E[N] → E`. That makes it the preimage under P of the open subscheme of points of naive exact order N. The definition `naiveExactOrderPreimageι` takes the first projection of this pullback to S. That projection is exactly the inclusion of the locus into S. The library proves it is a monomorphism (`mono_naiveExactOrderPreimageι`). It also proves the expected universal property (`exists_lift_naiveExactOrderPreimageι_iff`): a morphism T → S factors through it iff the base change of P to T has naive exact order N. Both results match the intended object. The setting is a fixed elliptic curve over a base scheme, which the construction needs, so it is not too narrow. Mathlib has no counterpart.
